key_values.event_name: May 2024 Papua New Guinea Enga landslide

criteria.name: Answer schema
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with all requested numeric fields, ledger score, classification, and one-sentence interpretation.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for parseable JSON that omits one field or has minor nesting problems.

criteria.name: Input extraction
criteria.description: Uses 6074.963 people, -34.495 dB minimum VV change, 0.474423 maximum dNBR, and the five same-day precipitation candidates.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct data family up to 4 points.

criteria.name: Surface margins
criteria.description: Computes radar_margin_db = 14.495 and optical_margin = 0.024 within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for each correct surface margin; award 1 point for a correct formula with an arithmetic error.

criteria.name: Exposure and rain margins
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 1.5 points for exposure, 1 point for precipitation maximum, and 1.5 points for precipitation margin.

criteria.name: Gate ledger
criteria.description: Marks all four gates true and totals ledger_score = 4.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct pair of gate state and score contribution, up to 3 points.

criteria.name: Final classification
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for a near-equivalent label tied to score 4.

criteria.name: Interpretation discipline
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation tied to computed thresholds and avoids exact loss or cause statements not derived from the ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for a mostly ledger-tied sentence with one extra uncomputed detail.
